attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to route between lan-a (node2, eth1) and lan-b (node3, eth2) subnets 10.50.10.0/24 and 10.50.20.0/24, with static routes on node2/node3 pointing to node1 as gateway for the peer subnet. No NAT was applied, so original source addresses are preserved. Verified ICMP and arbitrary-port TCP connectivity in both directions. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3) one at a time, confirming boot ID changes and post-restart persistence of interface config, routes, and end-to-end connectivity with source-address preservation intact.
